This podcast episode features a conversation with Jonathan, who personally built and tested over 4,000 paywalls and shares exactly what he learned along the way. We break down real-world insights into paywall design and how mobile app paywalls directly impact app monetization across subscription apps and freemium apps.

Jonathan explains how paywall optimization through ab testing paywalls led to clear wins, and how refining pricing strategy apps rely on can dramatically increase results. We discuss hands-on paywall experiments, including lessons learned using superwall, and how these decisions improved conversion rate optimization.

The conversation goes deep into consumer psychology and pricing psychology, showing how thoughtful ux design paywalls influence user behavior. Jonathan also connects these ideas to product led growth, long-term app growth strategy, and sustainable mobile app revenue.

Beyond mobile, this podcast covers how the same principles apply to saas monetization, ai apps monetization, and scalable subscription pricing models that work over time. This episode is packed with practical experience for anyone serious about app monetization and building profitable products.
